_about: The self-recall count for Rio Hondo College's Outline w/SLO report (358, 359) on riohondo.curriqunet.com (kb/_course_outcomes_read.py rows_recall; S691). The host reads outcomes only (d-ccsf-outline-trial-no-staff-names-s689), so the trial filed no page. Each count comes from the page itself: the trial printed each page's SLO and objectives sections, cut by their printed headings alone (EXCERPT_BY_HOST, OBJECTIVES_EXCERPT_BY_HOST), to its job log, and the worker counted the printed lines by eye. Every page answered 200 under both caps. slugs names the college this count stands for: a read for another college on the host is refused.

ACCT 100.from: the page's SLO section (IX. Student Learning Outcome to X. Texts/Instructional Materials:) and objectives section (V. Course Objectives to VI. Methods of Instruction:) as printed in the log of trial 44890279483, job 136804652509, read by eye line by line, apart from the parser; the lead-in line The Student Will Be Able To: not counted. The same sections printed identically in the logs of trials 44884988614, 44885957222, 44886389239 and 44889864455, whose counts caught two parser faults (the lead-in filed as an objective; objectives that open 'Students will be able to' read as lead-ins).
